status: digitally finalized aluminum-side V0.4 handoff; not a fabrication or riding release

shell_attachment.assembly: rear-loaded M5 bolts through the aluminum plate into the shell-side structural pads; final shell consumer selects grip length and locking hardware after ASA pad integration

shoe_attachment.fastener: M5 x 12 socket-head cap screw, 10 mm OD washer, medium-strength removable threadlocker

lower_shoe.manufacturing: mirrored monolithic CNC-machined shoes; no weld
lower_shoe.plate_side: inside/front face of the 3 mm aluminum backplate

solid_plug.fit_requirement: machine to a light sliding fit in each actual deburred rail; maximum target diametral clearance 0.30 mm

rail_stop.description: two 2 mm side shoulders created by a 23 x 19 x 1.5 mm collar; the collar is wider only on the head-X-projected cross-bolt axis so it clears the backplate

rail_cross_bolts.axis: head X projected perpendicular to the accepted rail axis
rail_cross_bolts.fastener: M5 x 30 through-bolt, two washers, M5 nyloc nut
rail_cross_bolts.fabrication: fit and clamp each matched shoe/rail pair, then jig-drill the complete stack; do not separately drill unmatched parts
rail_cross_bolts.head_side: head/washer on the head-centerline-facing rail side; washer/nyloc on the outer-facing side

lower_shoe.anti_crush_load_path: M5 head and washer -> 2 mm near tube wall -> fitted solid 6061 plug -> 2 mm far tube wall -> washer and nyloc nut; the plug, not an unsupported hollow wall, reacts clamp load
prohibited: welding the shoe to the tube or plate
using printed polymer in the bike-connector primary load path
tightening a cross-bolt across an empty hollow tube
forcing an oversize plug into the measured rail

rails.ends: square cuts perpendicular to the tube axis; deburr inside and outside without shortening below finished tolerance
rails.matched_pair_rule: label left/right and lower/upper ends before drilling; do not swap a rail away from its transfer-drilled shoe

service_interface.printed_shell_pass_through: none; the rear bezel is removed and the rails enter through the open rear service aperture
sequence: bolt the two fitted shoes to the inside/front face of the aluminum backplate
slide the labeled rails over the solid plugs until both lower cut ends contact the side-shoulder stops
install the four lower M5 through-bolts
offer the metal/backplate/rail assembly through the open rear service aperture
seat the rail upper ends in the unchanged 21 mm V6.1 sockets
install the two upper M4 socket cross-bolts
install the six rear-loaded M5 backplate-to-shell fasteners
install the open rear bezel only after all structural fasteners are torqued and witnessed

release_holds: the current V6.1 rear bezel has a localized collision with the now-final metal shoes; shell session must regenerate its rear bezel and six structural pads from this exact handoff and rerun the complete A-39 collision/service sequence
the actual rail inside dimensions and corner radii must be checked before machining the solid plugs
a physical rear-interface/shoe coupon must prove plug fit, access, clamp behavior, and repeatable assembly
complete headlight housing, beam, steering sweep, and cable clearance remain unresolved
stationary proof load, vibration inspection, independent metal tether, and progressive low-speed ride tests remain mandatory
